mapper.select: SELECT NOTICE_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEW_COUNT, IS_PINNED, REG_DT, UPD_DT FROM SYSTEM_NOTICES ORDER BY IS_PINNED DESC, REG_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYSTEM_NOTICES ( NOTICE_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, IS_PINNED, IS_PUSH, REG_DT ) VALUES ( SEQ_SYSTEM_NOTICE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{isPinned, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{isPush, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE SYSTEM_NOTICES SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, IS_PINNED = #{isPinned}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
